1193723.reason: GHSA-26w7-cxv4-gfx2 — Astro RCE through AVIF image optimization (fix requires Sharp 0.35.4, released only in astro>=7.2.8; the underlying flaw is in libheif inside Sharp, not Astro's own code). Does not apply to this repo for two independent reasons: (1) the pnpm override already pins sharp to >=0.35.4 <0.36, and pnpm-lock.yaml resolves sharp@0.35.4 — the patched Sharp is installed regardless of the Astro version; (2) the vulnerable path is unreachable — verified on disk at 0d19c1d7: zero occurrences of astro:assets/<Image>/<Picture>/getImage/inferRemoteSize under web/src, zero AVIF/HEIC/HEIF files anywhere in the repo, web/src/assets/ (Astro's processed-image directory) does not exist, astro.config.mjs sets no image.domains/image.remotePatterns so remote images are refused, no API route accepts an image upload (all request.formData() call sites are text-only auth/admin forms), and no source file imports the sharp package directly. The 85 raster images in the repo all live under web/public/ (served statically, bypassing Astro's image pipeline entirely) or web/vendor/brand/assets (vendored icons). Would apply again if: astro:assets/<Image>/<Picture>/getImage usage is added, image.remotePatterns or image.domains is configured, an image-upload endpoint is added, or the sharp override floor drops below 0.35.4 — remove this entry immediately if any of those land. The real fix is the Astro 6->7 migration (6.4.8 is the final 6.x release; the fix exists only in >=7.2.8); that migration is out of scope here and tracked separately as a PCI, not deferred by this entry.
